prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Try Controlling Your Desktop Pet", "Practice dragging, hiding, and talking to your pet right here before finishing setup.", "Right-click your desktop pet anytime to open controls or hide it to system tray."]
1: ["Sign in with your original account method to keep your adopted pet and saved settings."]
2: ["Preparing Your Pet Desktop Workspace", "We are placing your pet on your desktop. If your pet is not visible, check your system tray."]
3: ["Desktop Companion Quick Controls", "Double-click your pet to chat, drag to reposition, or right-click to send to system tray.", "Desktop Control Tip"]
4: ["Pre-made pets load immediately, while custom pets use photo upload during adoption."]
5: ["Upload a Clear Pet Photo", "Use a clear, well-lit photo facing forward for the best pet generation result.", "Supported formats: PNG, JPG. Ensure the pet subject is well-centered."]
6: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Check your desktop corner or system tray icons to see your pet. Right-click anytime for options."]
7: []
8: ["Sync & Safeguard Your Pet Profile", "Sign in to save your adoption progress and restore any existing pets linked to your account."]
9: ["Setting Up Desktop Pet Workspace", "Your pet is getting ready to appear on your desktop."]
